annotations.title: Draft a new agent from my skills

description: Draft a new Dactic agent for a task the user describes, built only from the user's own Dactic skills, policies and work context. Runs in the background: it returns a task_id at once; call get_task_status with it until the status is succeeded or failed. The result is a draft saved for review in the Dactic app — it is never deployed from here. If none of the user's skills fit, the result says not_enough_material: then offer create_agent_from_process, which builds the agent and its new skills from the process the user describes. If the user's existing agents or drafts already use every skill that fits, the result says existing_agent_covers and names them instead of drafting a duplicate; for a genuinely new process use create_agent_from_process. target_platform claude only for now.
name: synthesize_agent
title: Draft a new agent from my skills
